q: li
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Journalism, or a related discipline.
li
1–3 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably within hospitality, tourism, aviation, F&B, retail, or lifestyle sectors.
li
Previous experience in the KSA market is preferred.
li
Good understanding of integrated marketing, social media, content creation, digital platforms, and basic campaign reporting.
li
Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Arabic and English.
li
Good copywriting, proofreading, and content localization skills.
li
Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with social media, content management, and marketing platforms is an advantage.
li
Strong organizational, coordination, and time-management skills with good attention to detail.
li
Creative, proactive, hands-on, and willing to learn.
li
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
li
Ability to work effectively with internal teams, agencies, suppliers, and operational stakeholders.
p
Willingness to travel within KSA when required.
r: li
Support the execution of KSA marketing campaigns and activities across PPG brands, lounges, services, and commercial initiatives.
li

Coordinate the development, adaptation, production, and distribution of marketing collateral, presentations, brochures, POSM, signage, digital assets, and other branded materials in line with brand guidelines.
li
Coordinate KSA social media content requirements with the HQ Social Media team and approved third-party agencies, including content planning, asset collection, localization, and publishing support.
li
Maintain accurate and up-to-date information across relevant websites, digital platforms, listings, and customer touchpoints.
li
Support marketing activities related to new openings, product and service launches, promotions, events, exhibitions, partnerships, and special activations.
li

Coordinate day-to-day deliverables with creative, PR, social media and other agencies, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure activities are delivered on time and according to agreed requirements.
li
Assist with PR, media, influencer, photography, video production, and content creation activities when required.
li
Track marketing campaigns and activities and support the preparation of regular marketing reports, campaign updates, media coverage summaries, and performance reports.
li
Support the collection and organization of campaign results, customer insights, market information, and other relevant marketing data.
li
Assist with marketing administration, including quotations, purchase requests, purchase orders, invoices, supplier documentation, and payment follow-up.
li
Maintain organized marketing databases, content libraries, photo and video archives, supplier records, and departmental files.
li
Monitor competitor activities, airport and hospitality developments, consumer trends, and relevant market opportunities within KSA.
li
Work closely with airport and lounge operational teams to coordinate local marketing requirements and ensure accurate implementation of campaigns and branded materials.
li
Support the Marketing Manager, KSA in delivering agreed marketing objectives, projects, and deadlines.
x: Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy.
You don't need to be from this industry; you do need to be passionate.
We will respect and value your background and perspectives
We will work together with integrity
We will share our incredible pride for job, company and industry
Bring passion to all that you do
Listen, move fast and think innovatively
Speak up, have ideas and share them
Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness

As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.

We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travelers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience which is both accessible and quality. Almost 25 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts.

In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa etc.

With the future of travel always in sight, we created Smart Traveler, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.
